notes: Complete list: 67 actions (src/actions.js) and 8 advanced feedbacks (src/feedbacks.js). Every definition is a plain assignment (actions.<id> = {...}, feedbacks.<id> = {...}) in initActions/initFeedbacks; nothing is generated at runtime.

Protocol: TCP via TCPHelper to the configured port (config field default 3002, src/config.js); commands are Christie serial-style strings in parentheses such as (PWR 1) or (BRT 0505) (src/api.js sendCommand). The module polls on a configurable interval. Variables and presets are not catalogued.

Almost all dropdown ids are strings ('0', '1', ...). The choice lists come from src/choices.js and are copied as written there, including model-specific lists (tpatBasic, tpatBoxer, tpatMser, warpSelBasic, warpSelMseries); the module does not hide actions per model (config field pjtype exists but the action definitions do not use it).

src/choices.js defines the key lampMode twice in one object literal. The later block (Auto, Still, Motion, Film) overrides the first (max brightness, maintain intensity setting, maintain power setting), so action lpm (Lamp Mode) offers Auto/Still/Motion/Film. The catalog records the effective (later) list.

Action mot (Motion Filter) passes choices.motionFilter, which choices.js does not define; its dropdown therefore has no choices (the presets loop over the same undefined key). Feedback input_slot passes self.inputSelect, which is also undefined. Both are recorded with a choicesNote and without choices.

Number options carry regex: self.REGEX_NUMBER and range: false. The module never defines REGEX_NUMBER and @companion-module/base 1.15.0 (the version available for checking; the module pins ~1.4.1, not checked) has no such property, so no regex is effective and none is recorded. Ranges are the min/max of the number fields; the command builders pad values with pad2/pad4 and do not clamp.

Actions lcn (Lens Center) and pps (Picture In Picture Swap) use the key label where all others use name; the catalog takes that text as the name. Companion reads name, so these two may show without a name in the UI (not verified against a running Companion).

Action def (Factory Defaults): the default is the empty string, whose choice is labelled No; id '111' (Yes) sends the command. Action sinSlot has two text inputs (slot, input) with useVariables: true; the callback resolves them with parseVariablesInString and concatenates slot and input without a separator. Its Target choice id 'PIIP' (label PIP) is as written in the source and builds (SIN+PIIP <slot><input>).
The action ids for the lens shift motors (lensshift_*) send (LMV+...) and (LHO/LVO ...) commands without model checks.
Feedback colorpicker defaults are combineRgb values converted to integers. Built on @companion-module/base ~1.4.1: options do not support expressions.
